question: Should the reviewer salvage the PR's manual-derived MRW/Spring/GLS details into the already-merged integration runbooks, or close the draft as superseded by the current docs?
rationale: The branch overlaps a merged docs implementation but may contain useful provider-manual details that require human source and secrecy judgment before publishing.

options.title: Reconcile into current runbooks
options.body: Patch the existing `docs/integrations` files on `dev` with only verified missing details and keep the current broader structure.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close the draft if the reviewer decides the merged runbooks and open follow-up issue already cover all useful remaining documentation work.

options.title: Revive the draft branch
options.body: Resolve the dirty branch against `dev` and review it as a replacement-style docs update, accepting the conflict churn.

recommendation.title: Reconcile into current runbooks
recommendation.body: Patch the existing `docs/integrations` files on `dev` with only verified missing details and keep the current broader structure.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR was explicitly reassigned to this reviewer for the docs review pass.
